# Recipe Nutrition

## POST `/api/v1/posts/{id}/nutrition/preview`
Preview cooking-aware nutrition estimate without saving
- operationId: `previewRecipeNutrition`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: `RecipeNutritionPreviewRequest` (required)
- Responses: `200` → RecipeNutritionEstimateResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

## POST `/api/v1/posts/{id}/nutrition/recalculate`
Save a new current cooking-aware nutrition estimate
- operationId: `recalculateRecipeNutrition`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: `RecipeNutritionRecalculateRequest` (required)
- Responses: `201` → RecipeNutritionEstimateResponse, `400` → ErrorResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `403` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `409` → ErrorResponse, `423` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/posts/{id}/nutrition/current`
Get current saved nutrition estimate
- operationId: `getCurrentRecipeNutrition`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → RecipeNutritionEstimateResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse, `409` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/posts/{id}/nutrition/history`
List saved nutrition estimate history
- operationId: `listRecipeNutritionHistory`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`, `query:page (integer)`, `query:limit (integer)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → RecipeNutritionHistoryResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse

## GET `/api/v1/posts/{id}/nutrition/status`
Get nutrition estimate freshness and latest AI job status
- operationId: `getRecipeNutritionStatus`
- Params: `path:id* (string)`
- Request: —
- Responses: `200` → RecipeNutritionStatusResponse, `401` → ErrorResponse, `404` → ErrorResponse
